# Price the rights, not just the shoot.

> Price commercial photography usage rights by channel, term, territory, and exclusivity. Free local-first quote worksheet for photographers.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
